them.zh: PURE 指引的 agent 做的

steps.en: Review and merge the file workflow into your project and load its agent context
steps.zh: 评审并合并文件工作流，在宿主加载上下文

steps.en: Fill and approve one intent with its outcome and constraints
steps.zh: 填写并批准一个意图、结果和约束

steps.en: Follows UNIFY instructions to draft a spec and execution plan
steps.zh: 按 UNIFY 指令起草规格和执行计划

steps.en: Review the spec and explicitly approve LAUNCH
steps.zh: 评审规格并明确批准 LAUNCH

steps.en: Follows the phase protocol and writes intent-linked knowledge blocks
steps.zh: 按阶段协议执行并写关联意图的知识块

value.en: The next agent can resume from an approved intent and a stored phase record
value.zh: 下一轮 agent 能从已批意图与存储阶段记录续接
